## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated
- [ ] `pytest -q -m "not integration"`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] Real Mermaid integration tests run when publication or rendering behavior changed

## Contract review

- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when user-visible behavior changed
- [ ] Original-image preservation and candidate isolation remain intact
- [ ] Security scan, parse/render, SVG inspection, receipts, and resource budgets are not weakened
- [ ] IR, provenance, sidecar, or compatibility changes are documented
- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots are synthetic or safe to redistribute

## Notes

List compatibility, migration, security, or follow-up considerations. Use `N/A` when none apply.
